name: playbook
description: Find, organize, upload, share and publish creative assets in your Playbook workspace.

interface.longDescription: Playbook is a media backend for creative teams. This plugin connects your Playbook workspace so you can search images, video and documents by keyword or by what they show, organize them into boards, tag them and fill in custom fields, upload files from a URL, Google Drive or Dropbox, review version history, and share a board through a link or a published page. It acts as the signed-in Playbook user and reaches only the workspaces that account belongs to. It does not download file contents, read text inside images, or extract video captions.
defaultPrompt: What boards are in my Playbook workspace?
Find the logo files in Playbook and show me the newest ones.
Create a share link for one of my Playbook boards that expires in a week.

positive.description: List the boards of the workspace
positive.prompt: List all the boards in my Playbook workspace, including nested ones.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the board titles of the test workspace: MCP Test at the top level, with Brand Kit, Product Photos and Campaign Drafts inside it.

positive.prompt: Find the assets tagged logo in Playbook.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the assets tagged logo in the test workspace with their titles and links.

positive.description: Create a board and add a note to it
positive.prompt: Create a Playbook board called Review Demo and add a note that says Kickoff on Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Review Demo board, adds the note to it, and returns a link to the board.

positive.prompt: Add the tag approved to the asset named Logo Primary in my Brand Kit board.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Logo Primary and adds the tag approved to it, keeping its other tags.

positive.description: Share a board with an expiring link
positive.prompt: Create a share link for my Brand Kit board that expires in 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a share URL for Brand Kit and states the expiry date.

negative.description: Reading file contents is not supported
negative.prompt: Download Logo Primary from Playbook and read me the raw file contents.

negative.description: Sending email is outside the plugin
negative.prompt: Email the Brand Kit board to my whole team from Playbook.
Show me the boards of a Playbook workspace I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search, organize, upload, version, share and publish assets in a Playbook workspace.
